subtasks.title: Implement Enqueue method with nonce idempotency check
details: Create internal/jobqueue/enqueue.go
Implement Enqueue(ctx context.Context, req EnqueueRequest) (EnqueueResult, error) where EnqueueRequest carries Type, Key, Nonce, Payload json.RawMessage, SubmittedBy string
Step 1: validate that req.Type is registered; return error if not
Step 2: query jobs table for existing row with nonce=req.Nonce; if found, return existing job ID with Duplicate=false (idempotent retransmission)
Step 3: query for active job (status IN ('queued','running')) with type=req.Type AND key=req.Key; if found, return existing job ID with Duplicate=true
Step 4: INSERT new job row with status='queued', available_at=now(), generated UUID id, created_at=now(), updated_at=now()

task_groups.title: Implement Worker Loop: Promote, Poll, Claim, Execute, Finalize

subtasks.title: Implement promote step and poll query
details: Create internal/jobqueue/worker.go
Implement promoteFailedJobs(ctx context.Context) error: UPDATE jobs SET status='queued', updated_at=now() WHERE status='failed' AND available_at <= now()
Log each promoted job at DEBUG level with slog fields: job_id, type, key, status='queued', retry_count

Implement pollNextJob(ctx context.Context) (*Job, error): SELECT oldest queued job WHERE status='queued' AND available_at <= now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j2 WHERE j2.type=jobs.type AND j2.key=jobs.key AND j2.status='running') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1

subtasks.title: Implement claim step with atomic WHERE guard
details: Implement claimJob(ctx context.Context, jobID string) (bool, error): UPDATE jobs SET status='running', updated_at=now() WHERE id=jobID AND status='queued'
Return claimed=true only if RowsAffected==1; return claimed=false if another worker claimed it first (RowsAffected==0)
Log claimed job at DEBUG level with slog fields: job_id, type, key, status='running', retry_count

subtasks.title: Implement handler execution and finalization
details: Implement executeAndFinalize(ctx context.Context, job *Job): call registered handler with job's context and payload
On success (err==nil): UPDATE jobs SET status='completed', result=marshaledResult, updated_at=now(); log DEBUG with job_id, type, key, status='completed', retry_count

On retryable error: increment retry_count; if retry_count > maxRetries, transition to dead_letter (log WARN); else compute backoff delay, set status='failed', available_at=now()+delay, error=err.Error(), updated_at=now(); log DEBUG with retry details
On permanent error (retryable=false): UPDATE jobs SET status='dead_letter', error=err.Error(), updated_at=now(); log WARN with job_id, type, key, status='dead_letter', retry_count

subtasks.title: Implement worker goroutine loop and Start/Stop/Wait methods
details: Implement runWorker(ctx context.Context): loop calling promoteFailedJobs, pollNextJob, claimJob, executeAndFinalize; after each job or when no job found, select on stopCh, poll timer, or wakeupCh
Implement Start() that launches n worker goroutines (from WithWorkers), logs INFO 'queue started', and initialises stopCh
Implement Stop() that closes stopCh to broadcast shutdown to all workers

Implement Wait() that waits for all workers to exit via sync.WaitGroup with the configured grace period; if grace period expires, cancel in-flight contexts and log WARN per interrupted job including job_id; log INFO 'queue stopped'
